headline: Verify every deployed static asset against the candidate manifest

items.title: Verify every deployed static asset against the candidate manifest
items.insight: The native CLI only enumerates TEXT_EXT. Recent releases separately compare changed images, leaving unchanged binary assets and fonts outside measured coverage.
items.evidence: Actual CLI detects corrupt and missing non-text assets, measures unchanged binary assets, uses the compared commit manifest despite dirty configuration, preserves default text behavior and fails closed on absent/invalid manifest. Full production acceptance includes complete all-served readback.
